scope: Three representative layers of one TRAIN document and head0 from the selected-codec GPU FP64 fit; not all training documents/heads and not deployment masks
shared_seed_note: The same full-time Gaussian seed is reused across layers; cross-layer independence is not assumed or needed by Bonferroni
method: Unchanged frozen run_pilot.py with exact full/chunk8/adjoint+Gramian and nested8/16/32 probes;1warmup+3timed repeats per method
no_selection: No seed/method/chunk/tolerance optimization; no speed-only promotion and no empirical coverage-rate estimate from one shared seed
